question: Add a registry-class field to the dossier schema: where does an ARIN type (DIRECT ALLOCATION, ALLOCATION, ASSIGNMENT), a RIPE status (ASSIGNED PA) or an APNIC type (ALLOCATED PORTABLE) go?
why: No schema field holds it, so the three records carry it in extras.registration_class and related keys; the vocabulary needs a term for it (AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12).
